changes: Admin assigns enabled plans immediately or as a queued renewal; keeps existing grants and usage
Assignments have stable request identity, scoped test/live entitlements, reason and detailed audit; no payment/order is fabricated
Quota exhaustion denies access while preserving subscription expiry
Current active entitlement total, used and remaining bytes shown with progress; queued/refunded/expired grants excluded
Website and EXE distinguish exhausted quota from expired subscription
compatibility: Existing legacy account grants remain unchanged. In commercial mode, direct plan assignment for those legacy accounts is available after the legacy grant expires; ordinary commercial entitlement accounts can be assigned immediately or renewed.
